title: Estate Planning Intake Form
subtitle: A controlled intake and triage record for a jurisdiction-neutral estate-planning intake that captures planning participants, family and beneficiary relationships, existing instruments, asset and liability categories, fiduciary candidates, objectives, capacity and influence concerns, conflict review, document follow-up, and qualified-lawyer handoff, carrying facts and source evidence through qualified decision, exception escalation, secure communication, and accountable handoff.
description: This original Estate Planning Intake Form helps the estate-planning intake coordinator and qualified lawyer manage a jurisdiction-neutral estate-planning intake that captures planning participants, family and beneficiary relationships, existing instruments, asset and liability categories, fiduciary candidates, objectives, capacity and influence concerns, conflict review, document follow-up, and qualified-lawyer handoff. It opens the record, classifies the request, captures source facts and urgency, and routes a qualified accept, defer, decline, or escalation decision, while keeping jurisdiction-specific conclusions and professional judgment with authorized reviewers.
use_case: Use when the estate-planning intake coordinator and qualified lawyer needs one fillable record that opens the record, classifies the request, captures source facts and urgency, and routes a qualified accept, defer, decline, or escalation decision for the estate-planning inquiry. Close only after the intake disposition is supported by evidence and accepted by the named recipient.

sections.title: Estate Planning Intake record identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable record, establish authority, and assign accountable qualified review.

blocks.label: Estate Planning Intake record and responsible parties
Intake and Triage timing and route
Confidential record boundary
blocks.guidance: Use approved secure systems for protected communications and source files. Do not enter access credentials, complete account numbers, government identifiers, medical detail, or privileged source content in this routing form.

sections.title: Estate Planning Intake facts and source evidence
sections.guidance: Capture domain-specific facts, distinguish statements from verified evidence, and retain source references.

blocks.label: Estate Planning Intake matter profile
Estate Planning Intake evidence checkpoints
items: Each prospective client, relationship, and intended representation is explicit
Children, dependents, beneficiaries, fiduciaries, and relevant family relationships are mapped
Existing wills, trusts, powers, directives, agreements, and beneficiary designations are inventoried
Assets and liabilities are recorded by category and approximate range, not account credentials
Real property, business, digital asset, insurance, retirement, and tax issues are flagged
Planning objectives and concerns are recorded in each participant's own terms
Capacity, language, accommodation, coercion, and undue-influence concerns are escalated
No document choice, tax result, or legal conclusion is determined by this intake
blocks.guidance: Check only supported items; explain any limitation in the evidence narrative.

blocks.label: Estate Planning Intake evidence and action register
blocks.guidance: Reference approved repositories; do not copy confidential source contents into the table.

sections.title: Estate Planning Intake intake and triage control record
sections.guidance: Turn the record purpose into traceable evidence, accountable actions, and reviewable decisions.

blocks.label: Requested outcome, contact, and triage basis
Estate Planning Intake intake interview controls
items: The prospective planning client describes the requested outcome in their own terms
The estate-planning inquiry is classified before any substantive action
Material dates, amounts, persons, and assumptions are read back for confirmation
Statements are visibly separated from verified records and third-party reports
Only necessary information is requested through an approved secure route
Language, access, accommodation, and communication needs are routed
No promise of representation, result, filing, clearance, or deadline action is made
Urgent, suspicious, unsafe, or professionally restricted matters are escalated

blocks.label: Initial question, response, and evidence map
Neutral intake summary, unresolved questions, and proposed next step

sections.title: Estate Planning Intake stop conditions, exceptions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Stop when authority, identity, evidence, deadline, confidentiality, or professional-duty controls are unresolved.

blocks.label: Stop and escalate when any condition is present
items: Joint or multiple representation may create divergent interests or confidentiality limits
A prospective client may lack capacity, independence, or informed understanding
A family member, caregiver, beneficiary, or other person may exert undue influence
An imminent health event, marriage, divorce, death, move, sale, or tax date creates urgency
Existing documents, beneficiary designations, titles, or agreements appear inconsistent
Out-of-state property, citizenship, domicile, trust, business, or tax issues need specialist review
A fiduciary, beneficiary, creditor, former client, or related person creates a conflict concern
Sensitive financial or health information is requested beyond what intake presently needs
blocks.guidance: A checked item requires immediate protective action, a named owner, qualified review, and a final disposition.

blocks.label: Intake and Triage exception and escalation register
Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed

blocks.label: Qualified review and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This template records operational facts and does not determine legal rights, professional duties, privilege, conflicts, consentability, deadlines, or court compliance. Follow applicable jurisdictional rules and current firm policy; route legal, ethics, privacy, tax, court, safety, and specialist questions to authorized reviewers.

sections.title: Estate Planning Intake qualified decision and accountable authorization
sections.guidance: Record the authorized decision separately from preliminary analysis and prevent action beyond its evidence and scope.

blocks.label: Intake and Triage qualified decision
Estate Planning Intake decision and execution conditions
items: Qualified lawyer determines each client identity and whether joint representation is appropriate
Conflict review covers participants, beneficiaries, fiduciaries, businesses, and adverse relationships
Planning objectives are separated from legal, tax, valuation, and investment conclusions
Document needs and specialist referrals are provisional until qualified analysis
Capacity, influence, language, disability, and independent-counsel questions are resolved
Engagement scope, excluded services, fees, confidentiality, and next steps are explicit
blocks.guidance: Check only controls supported by cited evidence; unresolved items remain open conditions.

blocks.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up

fields.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up

blocks.label: Preparation, qualified review, and independent authorization
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and scope; they do not replace required agreements, consents, notices, filings, or system approvals.

blocks.label: Decision-use limitation
blocks.guidance: Do not use this Estate Planning Intake record as a substitute for legal advice, a required client agreement, informed consent, court paper, discovery response, privilege review, or specialist determination. Execute only the action evidenced in the approved system of record.

sections.title: Estate Planning Intake completion, evidence reconciliation, and handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when the outcome is evidenced, limitations remain visible, and every open action has an accountable owner.

blocks.label: Intake and Triage outcome and primary handoff
Estate Planning Intake closeout evidence
items: Intake disposition and prospective-client communication are documented
Conflict, capacity, influence, urgency, and specialist-review issues have owners
Requested documents and secure transfer instructions are issued proportionately
No original document or sensitive record lacks a custody disposition
Engagement or non-engagement status and deadline responsibility are clear
Qualified lawyer accepts the planning consultation handoff or records another route
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items require an exception disposition or a documented reopen trigger.
